chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Ash'ari, from Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him), who said:

The elephant is a morphed creature; it was an adulterous king. And the wolf is a morphed creature; it was a Bedouin pimp. And the rabbit is a morphed creature; it was a woman who betrayed her husband and did not perform the ritual bath from her menstruation. And the bat is a morphed creature; it was one who stole people's dates. And the monkeys and the pigs were a people from the Children of Israel who exceeded the limits in the Sabbath. And the sea bass and the lizard are a sect from the Children of Israel who did not believe when the Table Spread (Al-Ma'idah) was sent down to Isa ibn Maryam (peace be upon him); they strayed, so a sect fell into the sea and a sect fell onto the land. And the mouse is the immoral woman. And the scorpion was a malicious gossiper. And the bear and the wasp were butchers who used to steal (cheat) in the weighing.

key_terms.السَّبْت: The Sabbath (specifically the Jewish day of observance)
key_terms.الْمَائِدَةُ: The Table Spread (referring to the miracle in Surah Al-Ma'idah)
key_terms.دَيُّوث: A pimp or one who is indifferent to the chastity of women
key_terms.مَسْخ: Morphing or transformation of humans into animals

ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual and historical reasons behind the transformation of specific animals according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) elaborates on the concept of *Naskh* (transformation), linking specific animals to the moral failings of their human predecessors, a theme rooted in the Quranic narrative of the Children of Israel. While the transformation of Banu Israel into monkeys and pigs due to Sabbath transgressions is well-known, this narration expands the scope to include diverse creatures like the elephant and wolf, attributing their nature to specific sins such as adultery, pimping, and dishonesty in trade. This reflects the Shia scholarly understanding of how physical characteristics and behaviors of animals serve as signs of the spiritual states of their ancestors.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yaya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan Al Ashary, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘The elephant is a morphed (creature), it was an adulterous king; and the wolf was morphed, it was a Bedouin pimp; and the rabbit was morphed, it was a woman who betrayed her husband, and did not wash from her menstruations; and the bat was morphed, it was (a thief) stealing dates of the people; and the monkey and the pigs were a people from the Children of Israel, having exceeded in the Sabbath; and the sea bass and the lizard were a sect from the Children of Israel who did not believe when the meal was descended upon Isa<sup>as</sup> Bin Maryam<sup>as</sup>, so they strayed and a sect fell into the sea, and a sect in the land; and the mouse, so it was an immoral woman; and the scorpion was a malicious gossiper; and the bear and the wasp were butchers who used to steal (cheat) in the weighing’.
en.sarwar: 14. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn al-Hassan al-Ash‘ariy who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, al-Rida’, Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

The Elephant is metamorphosed, he was a king who fornicated. The wolf is metamorphosed. He was an A’rabi and a pimp. The Fox is metamorphosed. She was a woman who cheated her husband and would not take Ghusl (bath) because of her Hayd (menses). The Bat is metamorphosed. He stole people’s dates. The apes and pigs were from people of banu Israel who transgressed on Sabat. Eel and lizard are from a group of banu Israel who did not believe in the table sent for Jesus, son of Mary Alayhi al-Salam. They strayed, one group fell in the sea and one group remained on land. The Rat is metamorphosed; it is the indecent woman. The scorpion is metamorphosed. It was a taleteller. The bear is metamorphosed and the wasp was a butcher who stole from the balance.’”
